summary: Nektar Therapeutics filed an Item 8.01 8-K disclosing that, on September 24, 2026, a jury in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California found Eli Lilly breached the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing under the rezpegaldesleukin license agreement. The jury awarded Nektar $90 million in damages plus interest set by the court. The verdict remains subject to post-trial motions and possible appeal. The filing is a litigation-update event, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or ownership change are stated.
